name: The-Leap
title_zh: 37 个技能打包成一套，装完按场景挑着用
tagline_zh: 不是单个技能，是一整盒工具。装一次，之后写文案、做表格、理数据、改代码都有现成招式，不用再挨个搜。
tagline_en: Not one skill—a whole toolbox. Install once, then have ready moves for writing, spreadsheets, data, and code.
why_zh: 它把零散技能收编成一套有目录的合集，装完像多了一个工具箱，按场景取用，省去逐个安装和记忆的负担。
why_en: It bundles scattered skills into one organized set, so you get a toolbox to pull from by task, skipping per-skill installs and.
limit_zh: 合集内技能质量参差，部分需联网或依赖特定环境；只覆盖通用办公与创作场景，不含专业领域（如医学、法律）深度技能。
limit_en: Mixed quality; some need network or specific env. Covers general office/creative tasks only—no deep medical, legal, or niche expertise.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A pack of 37 skills, pick by scenario after install
